baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus sequence moves from fleeing, to death meeting the fugitives, to their passive return.
baseline_models.mechanism: The addressees direct themselves away, but death is cast as the facing party that closes the interval; the subsequent return removes the last residue of control. Escape-motion is folded into arrival.

activation_trace.role: Literal escape supplies the outward vector that the mechanism reverses.
Two parties arriving face-to-face makes death a converging counter-vector rather than a stationary endpoint.
Return to a prior point closes the trajectory under an agency other than the fugitives' own.

changed_reading.before: Death is an unavoidable endpoint despite attempted escape.
changed_reading.after: The attempted escape is itself caught inside a geometry of convergence: every outward route becomes the route on which death faces the fugitive and return follows.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The return is to the knower of the hidden and the witnessed, followed by an informing about intentional deeds.
baseline_models.mechanism: Hidden and witnessed are not merely two stores of divine information. They are two evidentiary states that collapse at return: what escaped human sight enters manifest, articulated account, and intended action becomes reportable evidence to its agent.

activation_trace.role: Concealment from eyes supplies the inaccessible evidentiary state.
Presence with direct seeing supplies the exposed counterpart to concealment.
A declaration grounded in knowledge turns exposure into testimony rather than mere visibility.
A consequential report transfers the now-complete account back to the addressees.
Purposive action supplies the accountable material, keeping the model anchored in what they actually enacted.

changed_reading.before: God knows private and public deeds and will state them.
changed_reading.after: Return abolishes the practical shelter of concealment: hidden action crosses into witnessed testimony and is delivered back to the actor as an intelligible case.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The temporal construction 'you used to be doing' is the object of the future informing.
baseline_models.mechanism: Temporal being and purposive work combine to present more than isolated acts: a repeated operative pattern occupied the addressees' time. The future report converts that lived continuity into a completed, knowable account.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence and presence in time make the deeds a sustained temporal condition.
Intended action gives that duration an operative and morally attributable content.
The weighty report compresses the extended pattern into something the actor must recognize.

changed_reading.before: The addressees will receive a list of past deeds.
changed_reading.after: They will be confronted with the durable way of operating that filled their time, so the report discloses a formed pattern of agency rather than a loose inventory.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier movement of recitation into teaching and written form gives the addressees a life-side disclosure; the focus's informing after return becomes a second disclosure in which their own work is read back. Judgment closes an epistemic arc, not merely a punitive one.

activation_trace.role: Following in ordered succession makes recitation the first staged delivery of intelligible material.
Disclosure to a knower makes teaching an opening of what had not been grasped.
Ordered letters and the written object give the earlier teaching durable, inspectable form.
The consequential report supplies the later disclosure directed back at the learners.
Purposive work becomes the text-like content of the second disclosure.

structural_cues: 62:2 orders recitation, purification, teaching, and book before 62:8 orders return and informing.
The direction of knowledge reverses: teaching is delivered to them in life, while their enacted response is delivered back to them after return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two knowledge-transfer sequences; I infer that the final report closes and reverses the earlier pedagogy. A live alternative is that the mission sequence and the judicial informing are parallel but functionally separate.

changed_reading.before: The final informing is only the announcement of a verdict.
changed_reading.after: The final informing is also the last lesson: what was first recited and taught is answered by a disclosure of what the hearers actually made of it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier pair of lateness and catching up supplies a temporal grammar for the focus encounter. Human groups may remain 'not yet' joined, but death's meeting and the subsequent return terminate every interval of lag.

activation_trace.role: Deferral to a later time supplies the open interval in which someone has not yet arrived.
A later party reaching what is ahead supplies the mechanism by which temporal lag closes.
Face-to-face convergence converts eventual catch-up into an unavoidable encounter.
Return makes the closed lag definitive rather than a passing coincidence.

structural_cues: 62:3 joins 'others/later ones' to 'not yet caught up,' while 62:8 uses a meeting participle followed by 'then.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delayed joining and later face-to-face meeting; I transfer the catch-up geometry to mortality, where 'not yet' is real but never permanent. The alternative is to keep 62:3 solely about communal inclusion with no mortal resonance.

changed_reading.after: Mortality is the closure of every 'not yet': delay remains possible, but the later party and the awaited meeting always eliminate the lead.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated carrying of a revelatory book without inwardly carrying its demand creates a split between possessed payload and performed response. The focus report of work adjudicates that split: external cargo cannot substitute for enacted intention.

activation_trace.role: Bearing an entrusted burden supplies the possibility of responsibility remaining externally carried rather than fulfilled.
A book that uncovers written content sharpens the contrast between legible possession and lived enactment.
Intentional action supplies the criterion that cannot be replaced by bearing an object or title.
The final report makes the gap between carried material and performed response explicit.

structural_cues: 62:5 repeats the carrying root around a book while denying that the burden was truly carried; 62:8 names work, not possession, as the reported object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies external bearing, revelatory writing, and purposive work; I infer that final disclosure tests whether the carried norm became action. The alternative is that 62:5 illustrates only failed knowledge-bearing without defining the focus report's criterion.

changed_reading.before: The report recounts whatever deeds occurred.
changed_reading.after: The report exposes the conversion failure between what one bore as authoritative knowledge and what one actually embodied as work.

context_deltas.mechanism: The challenge to wish for death is followed by the reason for refusal: the hands have advanced something ahead. When the focus then makes death the approaching party and work the reported content, three trajectories intersect: the person flees, death approaches, and the person's own deeds are already waiting in front.

activation_trace.role: A wish pictured inwardly supplies the professed orientation toward death that conduct immediately falsifies.
Loss of life names the same destination that becomes the focus ayah's active meeting party.
Advancing to the front gives prior deeds a spatial lead over the person who made them.
What the hands earned identifies agency, not an alien fate, as the source of what was sent ahead.
Flight supplies the belated backward vector of the agent.
Convergence turns the destination into a meeting with what is already ahead.
Purposive deeds furnish the content encountered and later reported.

structural_cues: 62:6 challenges the claimants to wish for death; 62:7 says they will not because of what their hands advanced; 62:8 says the death they flee is meeting them.
The focus report explicitly identifies their prior work as the terminal content of the sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wished-for death, refusal caused by hand-made deeds sent ahead, approaching death, and final work-report; I infer that the advanced deeds populate the encounter. A live alternative is that the advanced deeds explain fear causally without functioning as spatially waiting evidence.

changed_reading.before: An external fate overtakes a person who tries to avoid it.
changed_reading.after: Flight is already too late because the agent's own work has gone ahead; death is the rendezvous where maker, mortality, and pre-positioned evidence converge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The claim of exclusive nearness to God is tested by willingness to cross into actual nearness. The focus encounter makes that test unavoidable: claimed intimacy is converted from affiliation-language into face-to-face return, where its truth must appear in deeds.

activation_trace.role: A statement made without certainty supplies the untested status of the asserted intimacy.
Nearness without an intervening gap gives the claim its literal relational force.
Otherness and exclusion sharpen the claim from simple nearness into privileged nearness apart from people.
Truth realized in promise and action makes conduct, rather than title, the test of the claim.
Face-to-face arrival converts figurative claimed proximity into an unavoidable realized proximity.
Intentional deeds supply the evidence by which the asserted relation is tested.

structural_cues: 62:6 moves from an exclusive affiliation claim to a conditional challenge about death; 62:8 forces the meeting that the claimants refuse to desire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies claimed nearness, exclusivity, a truth condition, and resisted death; I infer that death functions as a proximity test. The alternative is that the challenge only refutes rhetoric and does not recast the focus meeting relationally.

changed_reading.before: Death is simply the enemy feared by the addressees.
changed_reading.after: Death is also the involuntary realization of a nearness they claimed voluntarily, exposing whether privileged intimacy existed in enacted truth or only in speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus sequence distinguishes several motions: a call establishes a center, purposeful movement approaches it, completed worship permits spreading out, and distraction breaks the gathered body apart. Against that choreography, fleeing death is not condemned as motion but exposed as a vector organized by avoidance that nevertheless ends in encounter.

activation_trace.role: A raised call establishes the audible center to which responsive movement can orient.
A day, place, or summons that gathers people supplies centripetal social form.
Intentional movement toward a sought object models directed response rather than panicked velocity.
Opening and spreading supplies legitimate outward movement after the gathering's completion.
A gathered body breaking apart supplies disoriented dispersion under competing attraction.
Escape is the focus ayah's outward motion, now distinguishable by its governing aim.
Convergence shows that the evasive vector cannot abolish the center it denies.

structural_cues: 62:9 moves from call to gathering to intentional approach; 62:10 authorizes dispersion after completion; 62:11 depicts attraction-driven disintegration.
The focus ayah sits immediately before this dense choreography of directed movement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distinct verbs of call, convergence, seeking, spreading, and disintegration; I arrange them as a field of vectors defined by their center. The alternative is to treat each as a local instruction with no bearing on the earlier flight.

changed_reading.before: The ayah warns that physical escape from death is impossible.
changed_reading.after: The ayah diagnoses orientation: movement can answer a call, seek provision, or fragment under distraction, but flight organized around denying the final center curves back into meeting it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated commands to bring God back into active remembrance make the focus's later informing directional: it is not acquisition of facts by the knower, but restoration of the actor's own obscured history. The report forces sustained work back into recognition.

activation_trace.role: Bringing something back after forgetfulness supplies voluntary recollection at the call.
Repeated recollection amid resumed worldly movement shows memory must persist beyond the gathering.
Complete disclosure to the knower rules out any need for divine fact-finding.
The delivered report directs knowledge toward the addressees who must recover it.
Temporal being stretches the recalled object across the life they inhabited.
Intentional work is the history restored to recognition.

structural_cues: Remembrance is commanded at the gathering in 62:9 and again amid dispersed seeking in 62:10; 62:8 promises a later informing by one already named as knower.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated human remembrance, prior divine knowledge, and future informing; I infer that the informational change occurs in the addressee, not in God. The alternative is a purely declarative report whose function is sentencing rather than recovered recognition.

changed_reading.before: God will tell people facts about their deeds.
changed_reading.after: God will make them remember their own operative history without the evasions and attentional gaps that had kept parts of it practically forgotten.

context_deltas.mechanism: Visible commerce or amusement captures attention, diverts the group, and makes them leave a present speaker, while what is 'with' God is asserted as the better near reality. The focus pairing of hidden and witnessed therefore judges a regime of salience: what eyes seize can be treated as real, and unseen nearness as absent.

activation_trace.role: Direct visual perception supplies the lure's immediate evidentiary advantage.
Being occupied away from one thing by another turns visual salience into diverted conduct.
Abandoning the present speaker registers the behavioral cost of the captured attention.
Nearness and presence supply the counterclaim that unseen good is not remotely unreal.
Concealment from eyes names the domain that selective attention discounts.
Presence under observation names the domain that seems immediately compelling.
The diverted act, not merely the object seen, becomes accountable material.

structural_cues: 62:11 begins with seeing, moves through scattering and abandonment, then contrasts the visible attractions with what is present with God.
62:8 has already named a knower for whom hidden and witnessed form one field.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sight-triggered diversion, abandonment, divine nearness, and the hidden/witnessed pair; I infer a critique of selective reality-making by attention. The alternative is that the focus pair concerns omniscience only and the later scene concerns discipline only.

changed_reading.before: Hidden and public deeds are equally known.
changed_reading.after: The final report also exposes how the actors ranked reality: visible lures were granted governing presence, while unseen nearness was behaviorally treated as absence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent sequence suspends exchange, marks completion, resumes seeking, and then contrasts profit-seeking with apportioned provision. Latent wage and transaction branches inside the focus root for work let the final informing be heard as closure of an account: what was earned, exchanged, and received is distinguished.

activation_trace.role: Exchange for a price supplies the ordinary accounting frame that must be suspended for the call.
Completion and expiry supply a close after which the mode of activity changes.
Commerce as pursuit of profit supplies the human calculus of gain.
An apportioned gift supplies a counter-economy in which receipt is not reducible to clever acquisition.
The worker's wage activates settlement as one latent dimension of the work being reported.
Dealings between people activate relational transactions within the accountable work.
The consequential report functions as the terminal statement of that account.

structural_cues: 62:9 leaves sale, 62:10 resumes seeking bounty after completion, and 62:11 depicts commerce as both attraction and an inferior measure of good.
The focus's report of work stands immediately before this repeated economic vocabulary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exchange, completion, profit, provision, and work branches for wage and dealings; I infer an accounting model in which death closes the period of earning. The live alternative is that the commercial vocabulary remains a local distraction example and should not structure the final report.

changed_reading.before: The report is a general moral review of actions.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is also a terminal account that separates pursued profit, interpersonal dealing, earned consequence, and provision that was always apportioned rather than possessed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses the packet's non-dominant mapping from the focus return root to a branch about stripping away a covering, so it is deliberately form-distant and must not replace the ordinary sense of being returned. It remains anchored in the focus return plus the immediate hidden/witnessed contrast; downstream prose should mark it only as a secondary denudation image.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The passive return stands directly before the knower of hidden and witnessed reality and the report of deeds.

activation_trace.role: Stripping a thing of what covers it supplies a latent image of return as denudation.
Concealment supplies the covering whose practical force is removed.
Presence under direct observation supplies the uncovered state.
The delivered report articulates what the stripping has exposed.

changed_reading.before: People are transported back for disclosure.
changed_reading.after: As a contained secondary image, return strips away the surfaces that kept hidden and witnessed apart, leaving the actor uncovered before the report.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The surface verb plainly denotes fleeing, while this non-dominant branch concerns exposing, investigating, or drawing out what is inside. The reading is valid as a paradox generated by the same focus root and the later testimony/report sequence, but downstream prose should present flight as behavior that reveals, not translate the verb as investigation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The act of fleeing is immediately reversed by meeting and culminates in witnessed reporting of the fugitives' own work.

activation_trace.role: Exposure through searching or drawing out the inward supplies the paradox that evasive behavior discloses its motive.
The tongue as witness extends disclosure from visible behavior into expressive testimony.
The consequential report completes what flight had already begun to betray.
The purposive act of fleeing becomes preliminary evidence within the larger history of intended action.

changed_reading.before: Flight attempts to postpone exposure until the final report.
changed_reading.after: Flight already performs disclosure: the effort to escape reveals the inward relation to death and becomes an anticipatory witness before speech formalizes it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activates death-decree and revivification branches from context words whose immediate syntax concerns prayer being completed and people spreading out. The focus death-return sequence and the adjacent gathering keep the echo anchored, but it should be rendered only as a lexical micro-rehearsal, never as a claim that completing prayer literally means dying.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus moves through death and return; the immediately following ayat move through gathering, completion, and renewed spreading.

activation_trace.role: A day or call that gathers people supplies the small-scale assembly preceding completion.
The branch of decreed death lets ordinary completion resonate, at a distance, with mortal completion.
Reviving the dead lets renewed spreading resonate with animation after completion.
Literal loss of life anchors the distant completion image in the focus's explicit mortality.
Return anchors renewed animation in the focus's explicit post-death transition.

changed_reading.before: The death-return sequence stands apart from the later ritual and work instructions.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the adjacent cycle of call, assembly, completion, and renewed spreading becomes a small temporal rehearsal of mortal completion and return to active exposure.

strongest_changes: Flight became a convergent trajectory rather than merely a failed attempt to delay a fixed endpoint.
The preceding claim-and-refusal sequence made deeds already sent ahead the contents waiting at the mortal rendezvous.
The carried-book contrast changed final informing into a test of whether possessed knowledge became intentional work.
The later call, gathering, seeking, spreading, and disintegration differentiated responsive motion from evasive motion.
Repeated remembrance changed informing from divine fact-reporting into forced recovery of the actor's own obscured history.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah generated several coexisting geometries: death approaches while the person flees, prior deeds have already gone ahead, hidden action crosses into testimony, and surrounding communal motions reveal that direction is governed by the center one answers. The most unusual retained activations were return as stripping of coverings, flight as self-disclosure, and the adjacent completion/spreading cycle as a contained mortality echo.
remaining_uncertainties: The pedagogical reversal from earlier teaching to final disclosure is coherent but may be resonance rather than a causal frame.
The terminal-account model depends on latent wage and transaction branches of work and should remain exploratory rather than dominate the reading.
The stripping and resurrection echoes are explicitly branch-distant; their value is imagistic activation, not alternate lexical translation.
